newsitem.title: USA: First South Africa says to sell stake in division.
newsitem.headline: First South Africa says to sell stake in division.

text.p: First South Africa Corp Ltd said Tuesday its subsidiary First S.A. Food Holdings will be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in early June.
First South Africa said it plans to sell a 30 percent stake in the business and expects to raise $1.7 million.
The company said a public offer for subscription of 5 million shares, worth $2.25 million, will open on or about May 8.
The company said First Food management and employees have acquired 12.5 million shares, worth more than $5.6 million, in a pre-listing private placement.
The company also said First Food has concluded a pre-listing private placement of 20 million shares, worth $9 million, with several South African financial institutions.
The company said First Food owns Piemans Pantry, Astoria Bakery, Seemans Quality Meat Prodcuts and Full Foods.
